scope: Only pinned K={x,y,z>=0:xy^2>=z^3}, F=-25 log(xy^2-z^3)-25 log z; directional third derivative curvature; not polynomial hyperbolicity cone in R^3.
disposition: No priority-blocking predecessor or direct existing-theorem implication identified in inspected primary sources. No worldwide novelty or priority certification.

sources.source: Levent Tunçel, “Polynomial optimization with a focus on hyperbolic polynomials,” OWR 14/2017. [Author PDF](https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~ltuncel/publications/OWR-2017-14.pdf), [report DOI](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2017/14).
sources.inspection_and_role: Entire three-page author contribution; target paragraph on PDF p. 2, full-report printed p. 799. Defines algebraicity by homogeneous polynomial inequalities and curvature by the directional third-derivative matrix. Exact target match.

sources.source: Yu. Nesterov and L. Tunçel, [arXiv:1412.1857](https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.1857), [HTML](https://arxiv.org/html/1412.1857); [author PDF](https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~ltuncel/publications/1412.1857.pdf), internally revised August 2015.
sources.inspection_and_role: §6, §9.2, conclusion and citation trail. Author PDF has 29 pages; its Definition 6.1 and Theorem 6.1 use the required mixed condition. The Hankel log-det barrier belongs to the dual; the primal construction is lifted. ArXiv HTML and author PDF are separate editions/representations, not asserted byte-identical.

sources.source: J. Dahl, L. Tunçel and L. Vandenberghe, [arXiv:2509.10263v2 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.10263v2), [author PDF](https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~ltuncel/publications/2509.10263.pdf).
sources.inspection_and_role: Both current PDFs: 27 pages, internally revised June 16, 2026; byte-identical SHA256 `df11c946ad11073881ad5274a08edc3f25f4f1cbb153a5c36388d24ea717ad76`. Inspected §2.2, Definition 3.1, §6 p. 25, bibliography. The conclusion retains a broader universal-existence question; it does not establish the exact target's current openness.

Abstract record gives v2 June 12, 2026; HTML itself says revised August 24, 2026. Its negative-curvature definition and broad concluding question were inspected separately. Do not silently identify this HTML with the June 16 PDF.

sources.source: Roland Hildebrand, [“Analytic formulas for complete hyperbolic affine spheres,” arXiv:1305.4814](https://arxiv.org/abs/1305.4814), [HTML](https://arxiv.org/html/1305.4814).
sources.inspection_and_role: Theorem 3.2 family 5 and §4.2. Exact cone at p=3,q=3/2 and (x1,x2,x3)=(x,z,y). This is a prior cone family and affine-sphere construction, not a theorem of polynomial hyperbolicity or of the target's directional curvature.

sources.source: Scott Roy and Lin Xiao, [“On self-concordant barriers for generalized power cones,” January 30, 2018](https://optimization-online.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/6441.pdf).
sources.inspection_and_role: Entire nine-page original; especially Theorem 2, PDF p. 3, and its proof pp. 8–9. Exact nonnegative power-cone family, different parameter-(n+1) LHSCB. No third-derivative negative-curvature assertion. Theorem 1 instead treats a sign-symmetric norm power cone.

sources.source: Yu. Nesterov, [“Constructing self-concordant barriers for convex cones,” CORE 2006/30](https://optimization-online.org/wp-content/uploads/2006/04/1358.pdf).
sources.inspection_and_role: Entire text searched, composition framework and §4 example 3 / equation (4.8) inspected. Supplies self-concordance for a geometric-mean hypograph and related perspective constructions, not the extra cone-direction sign condition.

sources.source: P. R. Chares, [“Cones and Interior-Point Algorithms for Structured Convex Optimization involving Powers and Exponentials,” thesis, 2009](https://research.dial.uclouvain.be/bitstreams/3cee3b2d-84f2-4b1c-b8f9-68c15b654a07/download).
sources.inspection_and_role: Primary university repository, 233 PDF pages. Inspected Chapter 3, Theorem 3.1.1, Remark 3.1.2 printed pp. 92–93, and related conjectures. Scalar directional estimates and self-concordance; no identified mixed negative-curvature result. Full-document phrase search alone is not the basis of the conclusion.

sources.source: Yu. Nesterov, [“Towards nonsymmetric conic optimization,” CORE 2006/28](https://optimization-online.org/wp-content/uploads/2006/03/1355.pdf); later publication [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1080/10556788.2011.567270).
sources.inspection_and_role: Primary 27-page working paper, definitions and power-cone barrier construction inspected; publisher abstract for later version. Self-concordance work. Full working paper searched for negative-curvature terminology.

sources.source: Tor Myklebust and Levent Tunçel, [“Interior-point algorithms for convex optimization based on primal-dual metrics,” 2014 working paper](https://optimization-online.org/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/4671.pdf).
sources.inspection_and_role: Definitions surrounding long-step Hessian estimation and its negative-curvature equivalence. No exact power-cone certificate identified.

sources.source: Joachim Dahl and Erling D. Andersen, [“A primal-dual interior-point algorithm for nonsymmetric exponential-cone optimization”](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10107-021-01631-4).
sources.inspection_and_role: Publisher full text, §5. Explicitly exhibits failure of negative curvature for its exponential-cone LHSCB; a useful check against inferring curvature from self-concordance alone. This exponential cone is not an algebraic-cone answer to the target.

sources.source: Osman Güler, [“Hyperbolic Polynomials and Interior Point Methods for Convex Programming,” 1997](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/pdf/10.1287/moor.22.2.350).
sources.inspection_and_role: Publisher abstract/record and downstream original statements inspected, not entire 1997 text. Hyperbolic polynomial barriers and homogeneous cones do not by themselves give a nonhyperbolic same-space example.

sources.source: Roland Hildebrand, [“Canonical Barriers on Convex Cones,” 2014](https://pubsonline.informs.org/doi/10.1287/moor.2013.0640).
sources.inspection_and_role: Publisher abstract/record. Canonical self-concordant barrier existence and duality properties; no inference of target's mixed curvature from that existence theorem. Full article not inspected.
